rationale.consistency: Perfectly adheres to existing Git client patterns and appropriately utilizes the PR shared package conventions.
rationale.edge_cases: Robustly handles empty targets, mutually exclusive flag validation, absolute paths, and reusing existing worktrees.
rationale.scope: Implements the exact set of requested features without over-engineering or introducing unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Well-structured logic, straightforward conditional flows, and clean extraction of shared worktree commands.
rationale.robustness: Safely copies the Git client to avoid mutating shared state and properly leverages safe abstractions for Git commands.
rationale.maintainability: Excellent extraction of worktree logic into the shared package, ensuring consistency across PR and Issue features.
